title: For a finitely presented morphism and finitely presented relatively pure sheaf, flatness in fibre dimensions at least n is represented by a finitely presented monomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The theorem constructs universal partial-flatness strata by descending dimension induction, complete etale devissage with decreasing support dimensions, generic-rank loci and purity-controlled associated-point localization. This is a non-Noetherian universal representability result, far beyond ordinary openness of flatness.
